cohort: 453 pregnant women, 59 (13.1%) of whom were SARS-CoV-2 positive and 394 (86.9%) of whom were SARS-CoV-2 negative.
finding: None of the neonates born to SARS-CoV-2 positive mothers were infected with SARS-CoV-2, suggesting negligible risk for mother-to-child transmission.
mod_finding: C-section delivery was significantly associated with SARS-CoV-2 infection in mothers.
